source: Verified research, Gemini CLI 0.41.2 entry: bundled bundle/docs/hooks/reference.md and the installed source chunk-6DSAZLFF.js (hook_payload_example assembled from createBaseInput and fireBeforeToolEvent; skeptic verdicts: hook_pre_tool corrected, hook_session_start, hook_stop and hook_user_prompt confirmed).

sniff.source: Gemini hook_pre_tool: the hook env gets GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR, GEMINI_CWD, GEMINI_SESSION_ID, GEMINI_PLANS_DIR and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR is not used: Qwen sets it too. The payload names Gemini's own events (BeforeTool, AfterAgent, ...).

selection.bareNote: BeforeTool is not a Claude event, so with no flag and no Gemini env the deny is exit 2 with the reason on stderr; the skeptic found Gemini denies on non-JSON text with an exit code other than 0 or 1.

deny.source: Gemini hook_pre_tool: exit 0 with a top-level {decision: deny, reason}; hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision is ignored (skeptic: grep finds 0 hits).

context.source: Gemini hook_session_start (skeptic: confirmed): hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext; plain stdout becomes a user-facing systemMessage.

PreToolUse.source: Gemini hook_payload_example (BeforeTool), assembled from the installed 0.41.2 source

PostToolUse.source: Gemini hook_post_tool: AfterTool adds tool_response {llmContent, returnDisplay, error?}

SessionStart.source: Gemini hook_session_start: SessionStart with source startup|resume|clear

SessionEnd.source: Gemini hook_stop: SessionEnd with reason exit|clear|logout|prompt_input_exit|other

Stop.source: Gemini hook_stop (skeptic: confirmed): AfterAgent adds prompt, prompt_response and stop_hook_active
